source.background: Generated magenta chroma key, removed deterministically

references.purpose: Horizontal fence material and style reference

preparation.operation: Use the established native magenta hue key and spill removal; discard alpha below 24, crop to visible alpha bounds, and add two transparent pixels on each side without resizing or rotating.

review.notes: Prepared asset inspection on charcoal ground confirms upright spear finials along the vertical receding fence, with no magenta spill. Formal acceptance requires composed-screen review of the six sequential runtime slices at gameplay scale.
